events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) moves laterally into Richardson's (MIA) path and makes lower body contact that dislodges him and affects his ability to pass.
[Observable in enhanced review] Green (MEM) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Green (MEM) leans into and makes contact with Richardson (MIA) during his driving shot attempt, but the contact is marginal and does not dislodge Richardson from his legally obtained position.
Conley (MEM) places his hand on the opposite side hip of Johnson (MIA), but immediately removes it and does not affect Johnson's FOM.
Winslow (MIA) slightly extends his arm into Green's (MEM) body, but does not dislodge Green from his legally obtained position.
Winslow (MIA) makes marginal contact to Green's (MEM) arm and does not affect his control of the loose ball during the rebound.
Green (MEM) sets a legal screen on Adebayo (MIA) off ball.
Johnson (MIA) makes contact to Conley's (MEM) arm at the start of his drive, but the contact does not affect Conley's SQBR.
Conley (MEM) makes contact to Adebayo's (MIA) arm affecting his control of the loose ball during the rebound.
Gasol (MEM) slightly extends his arm into Winslow's (MIA) body during the pick, but does not affect Winslow's ability to defend.
Adebayo (MIA) moves into Conley's (MEM) path, firms up, and makes contact to Conley during the screen, but the contact is marginal.
Gasol (MEM) commits a take foul on Richardson (MIA).
Gasol (MIA) briefly engages with Adebayo (MIA) without affecting his ability to rebound or get to the ball on the opposite side of the rim.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) enters the lane prior to the release of the free throw shot from Olynyk (MIA).
Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly engages with Olynyk (MIA) without affecting his ability to rebound.
Gasol (MEM) slightly extends his arm to Winslow's (MIA) body, but does not dislodge Winslow from his legally obtained position during the inbounds.
Wade (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Mack's (MEM) drive towards the basket.
Conley (MEM) slightly extends his arm and makes contact to Adebayo (MIA) during the screen, but does not affect his ability to defend.
RLB shows Wade (MIA) makes clean contact to the ball during Mack's (MEM) driving shot attempt.

As Mack (MEM) is in the air, defender Wade (MIA) swipes down and makes contact to the ball. The RHH camera angle shows that as Mack begins to return to the floor without losing control of the ball, he purposely puts the ball to the floor as if to start a dribble. Once the ball hits the floor and Mack regains possession, officials blow their whistle and rule a jump ball. However, since Mack purposely puts the ball to the floor, he may not be the first to touch the ball and therefore a violation, not a jump ball, should have been called and the ball awarded to Miami.
Conley (MEM) commits a take foul on Richardson (MIA).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: RAR shows Richardson (MIA) does not step out of bounds after recovering the loose ball.
